Skilled in data quality management, data validation, root cause analysis, SLA governance, metadata management, and master data processes. Worked closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Compliance, and business teams to support data governance initiatives, audit readiness, reporting accuracy, and operational decision-making. Familiar with data profiling, data reconciliation, KPI reporting, governance workflows, and enterprise data quality processes.
